mapper.select: SELECT stock.STOCK_DATE, stock.MATERIAL_CODE, stock.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, stock.STOCK_NUM, stock.WEEK_YEAR, stock.IS_UNIFORMITY, stock.IS_DYNAMIC_BALANCE, stock.STOCK_END_TIME, stock.DATA_VERSION, stock.COMPANY_CODE, stock.FACTORY_CODE, info.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, info.BRAND, info.STRUCTURE_NAME, info.LOCATION_TYPE, info.MATERIAL_DESC FROM mes_product_stock stock LEFT JOIN T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO info ON stock.MATERIAL_CODE = info.MATERIAL_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate} AND MATERIAL_CODE = #{materialCode} AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT stockSTOCK_DATE, stock.MATERIAL_CODE, stock.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, stock.STOCK_NUM, stock.DATA_VERSION, stock.COMPANY_CODE, stock.FACTORY_CODE, info.MATERIAL_DESC FROM mes_unqualified_stock stock LEFT JOIN T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO info ON stock.MATERIAL_CODE = info.MATERIAL_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate} AND MATERIAL_CODE = #{materialCode} AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT STOCK_DATE, SPEC_MATERIAL_CODE AS MATERIAL_CODE, STANDARD_CODE AS STANDARD_LENGTH, STOCK_NUM AS STOCK, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM SPEC_STOCK_SYNC WHERE STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate}

SELECT STOCK_DATE AS OUTBOUND_DATE, MATERIAL_CODE, TYPE_CODE AS MATERIAL_TYPE, MATERIAL_NAME AS MATERIAL_NAME, STOCK_NUM AS OUTBOUND_QTY, UNIT, DATA_VERSION, FACTORY_CODE FROM ORI_MATERIAL_OUT_SYNC WHERE 1 = 1 AND STOCK_DATE = #{outboundDate} AND MATERIAL_CODE = #{materialCode} AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT MATERIAL_CODE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE, SPEC_DESC AS MATERIAL_DESC, SPECIFICATIONS, PRO_SIZE, EMBRYO_CODE, EMBRYO_DESC, PATTERN, HIERARCHY, SPEED_LEVEL AS SPEED, SECTION_WIDTH, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_BAS_MATERIAL AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT STOCK_DATE, MOLD_SLEEVE AS MOLD_MODEL_CODE, TOTAL_NUM AS QTY, MACHINE_NUM AS MACHINE_QTY, WAREHOUSE_NUM AS ON_HAND_QTY, OUT_NUM AS OUT_BOUND_QTY, PLAN_OUT_NUM AS OUT_BOUND_PLAN_QTY, DOWN_MACHINE_NUM AS DEPLANE_QTY, FORCE_OUT_NUM AS FORCE_OUT_BOUND_QTY, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MOLD_SHELL_SYNC AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
